entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Expose per-evaluation MSBuild import snapshots from MSBuildWorkspace #86531
  • ProjectData: multi-targeted .lscache resolves shared [frameworkPacks] without a TFM, so a net8.0 slice gets net11.0 reference assemblies #86529
  • .cshtml formatter repeatedly indents JavaScript closing braces with C# #86527
    Backlog
  • API proposal: SymbolDisplayPartKind.Discard #86525
    18.14
  • Not ideal type argument inference result involving inference through variant type parameters #86524
    Backlog

Closed

  • Add color picker when CSS color values entered #85580
    Backlog
  • 'GenerateConstructorCodeFixProvider' encountered an error and has been disabled #82157
  • Workspace APIs unusable on Blazor WebAssembly under .NET 11: AddProject takes a blocking SemaphoreSlim.Wait #84615
    .NET 11
  • `@section` inside a tag helper element is silently dropped (SDK 11.0.100 regression) #86459
    18.14
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12417.149 #86523
